propositions: No code movement is warranted; the prerequisite research concluded that every extracted concern already has exactly one owner and run() contains irreducible orchestration glue not suitable for moving.

A raise inside finalize_outcome outside both the ProviderSession with-block and failure-accounting try/except skips record_call_spend/interpret_failure/step_failures.record (tracked separately in fe75, out of scope here).
A telemetry failure boundary case—setup_tracing swallowing a configured-but-failing OTLP/Langfuse setup—lacks fault-matrix coverage and must be added as a new test.

All existing fault-matrix test boundaries (provider-session raise/close ordering, fallback-chain raise/close-once ordering, provider/output classification matrix, finalization-failure boundary) must pass unchanged with provider clients and fallback-owned clients closing exactly once in established order.
Before/after file sizes and complexity measurements confirm no behavioral delta: all files remain within 800-line hard cap and complexity baseline unchanged.
